knowledge_cards.claim: Constrain peak reduction by perceptual error and musical role, not crest factor alone.
Distributed peak control is a topology candidate, not automatically cleaner.
Lookahead trades transient retention and apparent loudness against distortion and pumping.
Oversampling and true-peak limiting solve distinct parts of nonlinear peak control.
Choose the true-peak ceiling from delivery requirements and post-codec checks, not a global hardcoded number.
Loudness-match limiter comparisons and equalise effective processing depth before judging quality.
When stems are available, exceptional source peaks can be controlled upstream before final limiting if role and attack are preserved.
A streaming normalisation value is not a mastering target; loudness is an artistic decision bounded by artifacts and delivery.

rule_candidates.name: distributed_peak_control_if_single_stage_fails
rule_candidates.when: final limiter audibly pumps, collapses transients or distorts at required delivery loudness
rule_candidates.undo: cumulative distortion, dullness or section imbalance increases

rule_candidates.name: limiter_time_constants_by_artifact
rule_candidates.when: choosing limiter style, lookahead or release
rule_candidates.change: audition programme-dependent distortion versus transient-softening/pumping tradeoff
rule_candidates.undo: punch loss, low-frequency modulation or non-harmonic harshness

rule_candidates.name: oversample_nonlinear_peak_control
rule_candidates.when: fast clipping or limiting is used
rule_candidates.undo: pre-ringing, transient softening or instability outweighs benefit

rule_candidates.name: delivery_specific_true_peak
rule_candidates.when: export destination and codec are known
rule_candidates.change: derive ceiling and TP mode from delivery specification and decode test
rule_candidates.undo: specification changes or margin is unnecessary

rule_candidates.name: source_peak_fix_before_master
rule_candidates.when: one source repeatedly drives master gain reduction
rule_candidates.change: test clip gain, envelope, source or bus compression/clipping
rule_candidates.undo: source loses priority or master does not improve

rule_candidates.name: perceptual_metric_is_advisory
rule_candidates.change: combine technical metrics, perceptual-error estimate and human rating
rule_candidates.undo: metric improvement fails to predict preference
